name: GaMeS (Gaussian Mesh Splatting)
aliases: Mesh-based adapting and modification of Gaussian Splatting
definition: A hybrid representation for 3D objects that integrates mesh and Gaussian Splatting (GS), allowing modification of Gaussian components in a similar way as meshes by parameterizing each Gaussian component by the vertices of the mesh face.
summary: GaMeS is a hybrid 3D representation that anchors Gaussian components to mesh vertices, enabling real-time editing and animation through direct, one-stage parameterization.
